description: Script to generate a Global Descriptor Table (GDT) for x86 CPUs based on ELF kernel binary analysis, including handling of memory addresses, TSS, and user space protections.

methods.name: create_gdt_pseudo_desc
methods.description: Creates a pseudo descriptor for GDT with address and size.

methods.name: chop_base_limit
methods.description: Splits base and limit addresses into parts for GDT entries.

methods.name: create_code_data_entry
methods.description: Creates a GDT entry for code or data segments.

methods.name: create_tss_entry
methods.description: Creates a GDT entry for a TSS (Task State Segment).

methods.name: get_symbols
methods.description: Extracts symbol table entries from ELF file.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for script execution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to generate GDT binary based on ELF analysis.
